summary: Gambling.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly financial data including revenue of $40.4M, net loss of $1.2M, and balance sheet items. There is no mention of any special-situations transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer.
